focus.jbig: Iran truce cools oil · risk-on, but Fed lands Wednesday
focus.jtag: U.S.–Iran paused strikes — crude drops ~7%, futures rise; FOMC decision Wed 7/29
focus.jnote: The environment improved overnight — but a big scheduled event now dominates. Over the weekend the U.S. suspended its ~two-week airstrike campaign against Iran and Tehran said it would halt retaliatory strikes as long as the pause holds. Oil gave back a chunk of its war premium — WTI fell roughly 7–8% toward $83, Brent toward $90 — and equity futures rallied, led by tech. But the tape is two-sided: chip names sold off on AI-spend worries, and the Federal Reserve's two-day meeting starts tomorrow with a decision Wed 7/29. Markets lean toward a hold but are pricing meaningful odds of a hike. A scheduled rate event inside the trade window is exactly when a Sniper cuts size and keeps DTE short.
focus.notdown: Regional banks / consumer-lenders (FBP, ENVA) and the earnings gappers are today's cleanest bullish setups — catalysts are behind them and levels are freshly minted. But an FOMC surprise Wednesday can reprice rate-sensitive financials in seconds, so any bull put must be 7-DTE and expire before the decision, at half size.
focus.notup: Chips / AI-heavy tech stayed under pressure on hyperscaler-spend fears even as the broad tape rose. That's a fundamental lean lower, but selling bear calls into an FOMC week — where one dovish line can rip a short-squeeze — is not a probability edge. Stand aside on new bearish premium until the Fed clears.
focus.why: Why YELLOW, not GREEN? Two independent gates. First, the FOMC decision is inside the next 24–48h — the master rule says a scheduled Fed event in the window cannot be GREEN and defaults to YELLOW (A-grade only, half size, 7-DTE that clears the event). Second, P(≥1% gap) at ~34% is right on the 35% line and the Iran truce is tenuous — a single headline can re-add the war premium. The de-escalation is genuinely good news, so this isn't RED; but disciplined sizing and short DTE are non-negotiable this week.

risks: FOMC decision Wed 7/29 — the two-day meeting starts tomorrow; markets lean to a hold but price meaningful hike odds. A scheduled rate event inside the window is why today is capped at YELLOW — keep every spread 7-DTE so it clears the print.
Iran truce is tenuous — the pause holds only "attack-for-attack," and Houthi forces claimed weekend attacks on Saudi Aramco Red Sea facilities. Any breakdown re-adds the oil war premium instantly.
Oil round-trip risk — crude has swung violently (up ~40% on the month, then −7% today). A reversal back toward $90–100 would revive inflation fear and pressure stocks and the long end.
Big-Tech earnings cluster — MSFT, META and QCOM report Wed and chips are already soft on AI-spend worries; single-stock gaps land the same day as the Fed, stacking risk.
Chip/AI-spend selloff — the Nasdaq fell ~2.1% last week on hyperscaler over-spend fears even as the broad tape rose; a growth-to-value rotation can drag the index on any hawkish surprise.
